title: Holographic Operators — Language Wiring Empirical Validation
honestyBoundary: Architectural operator model on public corpus + NOAA ingest. Language-as-wiring and matter-as-shadow claims remain narrative tier unless separately bench-tested.

experiments.title: Public-domain corpus ingest integrity
experiments.interpretation: Validates reproducible public text inputs (Gutenberg + US founding docs) for operator experiments.
experiments.honesty: Corpus is bundled for offline reproducibility; not a live crawl.

experiments.title: Operator phase coherence γ on public corpus
experiments.interpretation: In-silico operator product coherence using deterministic token phases. Tests whether Φ scaling yields highest mean γ on actual sentences.
experiments.honesty: Does NOT prove language controls quantum fields. Validates the defined operator metric on public text.

experiments.title: Information decoherence Λ under token perturbation (10k trials)
experiments.interpretation: Bootstrap perturbation of public sentences; lower Λ means slower operator decay under the defined in-silico clock.
experiments.honesty: Perturbation model is architectural — not laboratory quantum decoherence.

experiments.title: Nested vs flat communication complexity proxy τ
experiments.interpretation: Maps sentence token count n to nested parent+leaf visits vs flat peer mesh C=n(n−1)/2 — topology proxy aligned with Lattice Chat Agent nesting.
experiments.honesty: Visit counts only; paper ms latency table is illustrative unless separately instrumented.

experiments.title: NOAA SWPC live solar active-region ingest
experiments.interpretation: Validates public NOAA ingest for heliospheric register labels. AR numbers in the manuscript are interpretive clocks — not Φ-derived IDs.
experiments.honesty: Presence of AR3842/3844 in feed is optional. Offline fallback is a labeled cached receipt — confirm live data at swpc.noaa.gov for operations.

experiments.title: Sham null — word-order shuffle reduces φ coherence
experiments.interpretation: If operator coherence depends on syntactic order, shuffling should reduce γ — sanity check on the metric.

experiments.title: Cross-corpus φ coherence replication by source
experiments.interpretation: Each public-domain source family should yield stable operator coherence under Φ scaling.

experiments.title: Aggregate φ coherence vs linear/e — replication + bootstrap p
experiments.interpretation: Replicates E2 aggregate superiority; documents bootstrap p honestly (may be > 0.05 on small corpus).
experiments.honesty: Does NOT claim p < 0.001 holographic proof. Pass requires aggregate φ mean ≥ both controls.
